title: lodestone similiar to next update
description: This datapack adds in a recipe for the lodestone to be crafted with an iron ingot instead of netherite just like the next update adds
body:
This datapack updates the Lodestone crafting recipe in the current live Minecraft version to match the recipe from the latest snapshot. Previously requiring a Netherrite Ingot, the recipe now uses an Iron Ingot, aligning it with the changes made in the current snapshot.

With this datapack, you can experience the updated recipe earlier and keep your gameplay consistent with the snapshot's changes. Simply install the datapack, and the new Lodestone recipe will replace the old one, making your crafting process smoother and more aligned with the upcoming version.
